scope: Two 23-probe rounds in five native 4 KiB environments. Raw controls are not six high-level fallback acceptances.
sourceBinding: Base plus the exact changed probe source inputs in the receipt; not attributed to the unmodified base commit.

callPaths.pidfd_open: Asynchronous spawn attempts pidfd_open unless the waiter-thread fallback is already cached; EIO errors are returned after wait4, ENOSYS enables waiter-thread fallback. spawnSync fast path is not proof.
callPaths.copy_file_range: copyFileSync tries FICLONE first; fixture disables it with the exact upstream flag. Kernel >= 4.5 gates copy_file_range; EIO propagates, ENOSYS disables it and selects sendfile/read-write fallback.
callPaths.clone3: Only the cgroup_fd >= 0 spawn branch requests CLONE_INTO_CGROUP. Ordinary spawn uses vfork and does not verify this branch.
callPaths.epoll_pwait2: Android returns 0 from Bun__isEpollPwait2SupportedOnLinuxKernel. Timer/fetch success is not epoll_pwait2 fallback evidence.
callPaths.openat2: Beneath-root install and in-root static-directory paths are distinct; raw invalid arguments do not validate path confinement.
callPaths.fchmodat2: No direct high-level call found in the inspected Bun src tree; raw control only, dependency-origin path review remains open.

interpretation.raw: All six calls use invalid non-mutating arguments and return ENOSYS under an exact ABI-specific TRAP filter. Invalid prctl marker EINVAL -> ENOSYS proves filter activation even on old kernels.
interpretation.semantic: An ERRNO(EIO) layer first proves actual high-level call-path reachability, then the higher-precedence TRAP layer returns ENOSYS. The next two copy/wait operations must pass exact content/mode/output/exit/reaping assertions.
interpretation.oldKernel: Sony API 28 kernel 4.4.148 skips copy_file_range. Existing stronger seccomp action masks the pidfd EIO control. Safe operations still pass but those four observations do not prove semantic branch reachability.
interpretation.cleanup: Copy fixtures verify no descriptors referencing their private files; two successful pidfd child waits verify child PID disappearance. Force-stop and uninstall verify all probe UID processes are gone. This is not a complete all-FD or detached-descendant leak audit.
nextGates: new syscall suite on native ARM64 16 KiB and native x86_64 16 KiB blocker
matching experimental APK and corresponding-source publication
interpretation.release: Official runtime, production minimum API, signing, v0.2.0 assets/tags and development v0.2.1 publication status are unchanged.
